description: Wave folder with two folding algorithms, an offset that makes the folding asymmetric, and separate depth for the two sides

params.text: Drives the signal into the folder, from half level at 0 to double level at 1.5, so more of it creases over.
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at the CV F input before it adds to the FOLD setting.
Sets the depth of the extra folding on one side of the signal, 0 to 1; which side that is depends on the setting of the I/II switch.
Sets the depth of the extra folding on one side of the signal, 0 to 1; which side that is depends on the setting of the I/II switch.
Crossfades the output from the unfolded input to the folded signal.
Offsets the signal by -2 to 2 before it is folded, so the upper and lower folds happen at different levels.
Chooses between the two folding algorithms, which differ in the curve they apply and in which side UP and DN act on.
Scales the extra folding applied to whatever passes outside the fold window, 0 to 5.
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at the CV M input before it adds to the MIX setting.

inputs.text: Shifts the fold amount through the CV F attenuverter, a fifth of its range per volt.
Adds 0.4 to the UP setting per volt.
Adds 0.4 to the DN setting per volt.
Shifts the dry and folded balance through the CV M attenuverter, a fifth of its range per volt.

outputs.text: The incoming signal and the folded signal blended by MIX.

notes: MIX comes up at 0, passing the input through unfolded, so nothing the FOLD, UP, DN, SYM or RANGE controls do is heard until MIX is raised.
